meta.how_to: The source of truth for what we are doing. Edit it with `python -m gm progress set <id> key=value ...` (or by hand), then run `python -m gm progress build`. PROGRESS.md and progress.html are GENERATED from this file - never edit them. `status` is where the work is; `awaiting` is WHOSE TURN IT IS; a backlog card has awaiting "none" because nobody is holding it yet.

focus.note: The wave/biome curve and the §4.4 tower ladder landed together (LL-022). The tracker itself is now the thing to eyeball, then it is the §4.6 decision and a playtest.

tasks.title: Art direction and tilesets for regions 2-6
tasks.notes: Six biomes exist in the data (Grass, Swamp, Desert, Jungle, Graveyard, Blood Fields). Only Grass has art, so region 2 cannot be authored until at least its tileset exists.

tasks.title: Art for the Garden Book and meta screens
tasks.notes: Mastery nodes, the clover and blood trees, candy slots and the badge sheet.

tasks.title: Draw one or two new zombies
tasks.notes: There are three rigs (spawn_mon 0-2) and every authored stage draws from those. A fourth would let region 2's mix differ from region 1's.

tasks.title: Draw the four tower trios (12 sprites)
tasks.notes: Each tower needs idle / attack / return, matching the current spr_tower style. Roadmap 2.9 calls this the largest single art push in v1, and tower 2.8 (the other three towers) is waiting on it.

tasks.title: Add a dev-only LEVEL [CURVE] diagnostic
tasks.notes: Print m(w) at both ends of every biome plus the projected dps/required ratio, so a curve that has gone wrong is visible in the log instead of after a 60-wave playtest. Target: floor bite >= 0.35, ceiling bite <= 0.90 on Normal, <= 0.90 on Brutal with candy.

tasks.title: Play stage 1-1 and report the new curve
tasks.needs: Play one stage with global.devMode = true and paste the LEVEL log lines, plus how it actually felt
tasks.notes: Expect: 'wave 1/15', a boss on wave 10 and again on 15, and life rising gently to about x30 on the last wave (the old exponential hit x1036). If waves 12-15 feel flat the curve is too shallow; if money runs out before wave 10 it is too steep.

tasks.title: Make the difficulty columns actually change the fight
tasks.notes: difficulty_current() had zero callers, so Normal / Hard / Brutal differed only in payout. hp, speed, count, money and the starting-money column are now read where they belong.

tasks.title: Decide the rung price vs rung worth fix
tasks.needs: One decision: steepen the ladder to x3.4 damage at L5 (keep the 4.3 prices), or cut the rung prices to about 1.0 unit total
tasks.notes: economy.md 4.6. One unit of money buys +1.00 dps as a placement but only +0.16 as a rung, so upgrading is a trap and 'money buys the four rungs' stops being a choice. Every curve number in 4.5 is measured against whichever answer wins, so this goes first.

tasks.title: Commit the curve work, the tracker and the docs
tasks.notes: Untracked and must be git add-ed: scripts/GameLevelData, scripts/region_data, scripts/tower_levels, plus the new root files progress.json, PROGRESS.md, progress.html and README.md, and python_tools/gm/progress.py. One commit and no history, so nothing here is recoverable until it is committed.

tasks.title: Reload GameMaker and confirm the three new scripts
tasks.needs: Close GameMaker, reopen the project, and check that region_data, tower_levels and GameLevelData appear under Scripts
tasks.notes: pushing_daisies_recovered.yyp gained three resource lines. If the IDE was open while that happened, its next save rewrites the .yyp from its own buffer and the new scripts vanish (LL-008) - the error would be 'variable not set before reading' on a function this repo does define.

tasks.title: The HUD wave counter is one ahead of wave_count
tasks.notes: STATINV.waves starts at 1 while wave_count starts at 0, so the display reads one high and scr_zomb_pathSpeed computes speed for the wrong wave. Deliberately left alone during the curve change to keep that edit's blast radius small.

tasks.title: Build the progress tracker (this board)
tasks.needs: Open progress.html and say whether the board and the top strip are the shape you want - then tell me what to add, merge or cut
tasks.notes: progress.json is the source; PROGRESS.md and progress.html are generated from it and gm progress check fails if they disagree. The seed is a first pass, not a contract.

tasks.title: Fix the per-frame 'Unable to find instance' from _shadows
tasks.notes: A persistent instance whose dependency did not persist: _shadows survives the room change, _dayCycle does not.

tasks.title: One level object, and a deploy gate the data can pass
tasks.notes: The world map's 6x10 grid and the authored stage table were two sources of truth that never compared, so a stage could be deployed to that had no data and it silently played stage 1.

tasks.title: Persistent tower mastery XP per kill (the rest of 2.4)
tasks.notes: Money buys L1-L5 inside a run today; the tower LEVEL is supposed to persist in the save, which is what makes mastery progress between runs. The save schema already has the mastery key, so this is the earning and the spend.

tasks.title: Re-author par_spend and par_time for 15-60 wave stages
tasks.notes: Par is still the old 5-10 wave value, so the Frugal and Speed Grower badges are effectively unearnable. Stage 1 now pays out far more money than it did, which means every par number has to be re-derived rather than guessed.

tasks.title: Phase 3: the Garden Book (mastery, clover and blood trees, candy UI)
tasks.notes: The meta layer's face. tower_cap()/tower_floor() already read global.meta.mastery, so the floor-and-cap-by-mastery rule is in place and waiting for the screen that spends the nodes.

tasks.title: Phase 4: candy recipes and in-run play
tasks.notes: tower_data_at_level() is the single place candy and auras fold into a tower, so this phase adds a term there and nothing else has to move.

tasks.title: Phase 5: author stages for regions 2-6
tasks.notes: region_data already carries the curve, the seeds and the wave rule for all six biomes, so this is table-filling plus art - which is exactly what roadmap 5.6 promised. Blocked in practice on the biome art, not on code.

tasks.title: Push the repo (and the board) to GitHub
tasks.needs: say whether I should push to origin/frothzon pushing_daisies, and whether it stays private - the board only lives in the github once it is up there
tasks.notes: origin already exists. AGENTS.md 1.2 claimed there was no remote; corrected. Until this is pushed, the repo has one commit and a clone gets nothing.

tasks.title: Land the 4.4 non-compounding tower ladder
tasks.notes: A level was free compounding power: each purchase added the tower's CURRENT damage, so an L5 did 16x an L1. A level is now base x ladder, cap and floor come from the garden, rung prices come from a table, and selling refunds 60% of everything invested.

tasks.title: The other three towers: Chillip, Bindweed, Belladonna Blitz, Thornamental
tasks.notes: Slow, root, poison and crit. Their systems exist, so this is stats, art and a roster row each - but the art push (art-tower-trios) comes first.

tasks.title: 15 + 5 wave rule and the per-biome difficulty curve
tasks.notes: Waves are a rule now (15 in stage 1, +5 a stage, in every biome) and the ramp is per biome: 1.00 on wave 1 everywhere, rising to the region's curve_end on the last wave, bent quadratically because money grows with the square of the wave. This replaced 2^(wave/5-2) + 0.2(w-1), which hit x1036 at wave 60.

log.what: Fixed the per-frame 'Unable to find instance for object index 1': a persistent instance whose dependency did not persist.
One level object (GameLevelData) and a deploy gate the level data can pass, so the world map cannot offer a stage that has no data.
Waves became a rule (15 + 5 a stage, all six biomes) and the ramp became region_data's per-biome curve, replacing the exponential that hit x1036 at wave 60.
The 4.4 ladder: a level is base x ladder and never compounds; cap and floor come from the garden; rungs are re-priced and selling refunds 60% of what went in.
The difficulty columns are read at last - hp, speed, count, money and starting money. Before this, Brutal only paid better; it never fought harder.
Found that 4.3's prices and 4.4's ladder disagree: a rung returns +0.16 dps per unit of money against +1.00 for another placement. Written up as economy.md 4.6 and left open for a decision.
Built the progress tracker: progress.json as the source, PROGRESS.md and progress.html generated from it, and gm progress check failing when the three disagree.
Tightened the tracker: a backlog card may no longer be awaiting a person, because the top strip filled with parked work within the hour (LL-023).
